// Template: HTTP-triggered command/event feature.
//
// See docs/guides/intention-and-implementation.md for the rationale and
// docs/coding-guidelines.md for the surrounding repository conventions.
//
// How to use this template:
//   1. Copy this file to apps/<crate>/src/<feature_action>.rs (drop the
//      trailing .txt so cargo picks it up).
//   2. Do the search-and-replace below.
//   3. Delete any mods you do not need yet. `domain` is often empty in
//      early features — delete the empty `mod domain {}` until you have
//      something pure to put in it.
//   4. Declare `mod <feature_action>;` in the crate's lib.rs.
//   5. Add `pub use crate::<feature_action>::io::*;` inside the crate's
//      top-level `pub mod io`.
//   6. Add a `<FeatureRequested>` variant to the crate's event enum (see
//      `app_event.rs` in retailer-sourcing for the pattern).
//   7. Wire the route in `app()`, and register the handler in your
//      assembly's `start_mulac()` (or equivalent kernel boot wiring).
//
// Search-and-replace (case-sensitive; do each line as one substitution):
//   Feature              -> PascalCase feature noun     (e.g. DailySourcing)
//   FEATURE_REQUESTED    -> SCREAMING_SNAKE of the noun (e.g. DAILY_SOURCING_REQUESTED)
//   FEATURE_ACTION_PATH  -> route constant name         (e.g. DAILY_SOURCING_PATH)
//   feature_action       -> snake_case module name      (e.g. daily_sourcing)
//   /feature-action/     -> URL path                    (e.g. /daily-sourcing/)
//   CrateEvent           -> crate's event enum          (e.g. RetailerSourcingEvent)
//   <crate>              -> crate identifier            (e.g. retailer-sourcing)

// Intention — re-exported to the rest of the codebase.
pub mod io {
    pub use super::application::{
        COMMAND_TYPE,
        EVENT_TYPE_FEATURE_REQUESTED,
        FeatureRequested,
        StartFeature, //
    };
    pub use super::handler::FeatureHandler;
    pub use super::http::{FEATURE_ACTION_PATH, FeatureResponse, register, trigger};
}

// Exposed service — HTTP adapter.
mod http {
    use super::application::{FeatureError, StartFeature};
    use crate::assembly::io::BearerAuth;
    use chrono::Utc;
    use kernel::{
        NewCommandEnvelope,
        NewCommandMetadata,
        PersistentKernelState, //
    };
    use poem::error::ResponseError;
    use poem::web::Json;
    use poem::{
        EndpointExt,
        IntoResponse,
        Response,
        Result,
        Route,
        handler,
        http::StatusCode,
        middleware::AddData,
        post,
        web::Data, //
    };
    use serde::Serialize;
    use std::sync::Arc;
    use tokio::task::spawn_blocking;
    use uuid::Uuid;

    pub const FEATURE_ACTION_PATH: &str = "/feature-action/";

    #[derive(Debug, Serialize)]
    pub struct FeatureResponse {
        pub command_id: Uuid,
    }

    impl ResponseError for FeatureError {
        fn status(&self) -> StatusCode {
            StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR
        }
    }

    #[handler]
    pub async fn trigger(state: Data<&PersistentKernelState>) -> Result<Response> {
        let state = state.0.clone();
        let command_id = Uuid::now_v7();
        let envelope = NewCommandEnvelope {
            command: StartFeature::new(Utc::now()),
            metadata: NewCommandMetadata {
                command_id,
                correlation_id: Some(command_id),
                causation_id: None,
                source: Some("<crate>.http".to_string()),
            },
        };

        spawn_blocking(move || state.dispatch_command(envelope))
            .await
            .map_err(|e| FeatureError::Infra(e.to_string()))?
            .map_err(|e| FeatureError::Infra(e.to_string()))?;

        Ok((StatusCode::ACCEPTED, Json(FeatureResponse { command_id })).into_response())
    }

    pub fn register(route: Route, state: Arc<PersistentKernelState>, bearer: Arc<String>) -> Route {
        route.at(
            FEATURE_ACTION_PATH,
            post(trigger)
                .with(AddData::new((*state).clone()))
                .with(BearerAuth::new((*bearer).clone())),
        )
    }
}

// Exposed service — command handler port implementation.
mod handler {
    use super::application::{FeatureRequested, StartFeature};
    use crate::app_event::io::CrateEvent;
    use chrono::Utc;
    use kernel::io::{CommandError, CommandHandlerPort};

    pub struct FeatureHandler;

    impl FeatureHandler {
        pub fn new() -> Self {
            Self
        }
    }

    impl Default for FeatureHandler {
        fn default() -> Self {
            Self::new()
        }
    }

    impl CommandHandlerPort<StartFeature, CrateEvent> for FeatureHandler {
        fn execute(&self, _cmd: StartFeature) -> Result<Vec<CrateEvent>, CommandError> {
            let event = FeatureRequested {
                requested_at: Utc::now(),
            };
            Ok(vec![CrateEvent::FeatureRequested(event)])
        }
    }
}

// Models — commands, events, errors, and type-name constants.
mod application {
    use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};
    use kernel::{ApplicationCommand, ApplicationEvent};
    use serde::{Deserialize, Serialize};
    use thiserror::Error;

    pub const COMMAND_TYPE: &str = "StartFeature";
    pub const EVENT_TYPE_FEATURE_REQUESTED: &str = "FeatureRequested";

    #[derive(Debug, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    pub struct StartFeature {
        triggered_at: DateTime<Utc>,
    }

    impl ApplicationCommand for StartFeature {
        fn command_type(&self) -> &'static str {
            COMMAND_TYPE
        }
    }

    impl StartFeature {
        pub fn new(triggered_at: DateTime<Utc>) -> Self {
            Self { triggered_at }
        }
    }

    #[derive(Debug, Clone, Serialize, Deserialize)]
    pub struct FeatureRequested {
        pub requested_at: DateTime<Utc>,
    }

    impl ApplicationEvent for FeatureRequested {
        fn event_type(&self) -> &'static str {
            EVENT_TYPE_FEATURE_REQUESTED
        }
    }

    #[derive(Debug, Error)]
    pub enum FeatureError {
        #[error("Infrastructure error: {0}")]
        Infra(String),
    }
}

// Pure types with no infrastructure dependencies. Add types here when the
// feature grows logic that does not belong in `application`. Delete the
// empty body until the feature actually has pure types to host.
mod domain {}
